properties.name: Feedback Type
properties.description: Choose Evaluation, Bug, or Survey. Evaluation uses a deprecated schema field with a 2027-02-20 sunset and should be migrated when Cisco publishes a replacement.

properties.name: Comment
properties.description: Enter the feedback text. It must be nonblank and no longer than 5000 characters. The workflow never copies it into diagnostic or terminal outputs.

properties.name: Email
properties.description: Enter the feedback sender's valid email address. It is sent only in FeedbackData and is not copied into workflow result or error output.

properties.name: Account Name
properties.description: Enter the exact Intersight account name to persist with the feedback. It must not be blank.

properties.name: Evaluation
properties.description: For Feedback Type Evaluation, choose Excellent, Good, Fair, or Poor. Leave blank for Bug or Survey. This API property is deprecated and sunsets on 2027-02-20.

properties.name: Follow Up
properties.description: Allow Cisco to follow up about this submission. Alternative follow-up addresses require this value to be true.

properties.name: Alternative Follow-up Emails

properties.name: Product Satisfaction Scale

properties.name: Survey Completed

properties.name: Status Code

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Privacy-minimized JSON result containing only submission status and returned resource identity; never the comment or email addresses.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable final workflow outcome without submitted personal data.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure detail without submitted personal data; empty on success.

properties.description: Submits Evaluation, Bug, or Survey feedback as feedback.FeedbackPost with nested FeedbackData. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can create feedback posts. The workflow validates enums, a 5,000-character Comment, email formats, at most five alternative addresses, 0-10 satisfaction, and type-specific fields; FullStoryUrl and TraceIds are omitted. Diagnostics and outputs never echo Comment or email values, although the API transmits them. Evaluation is deprecated with OpenAPI sunset 2027-02-20 and must migrate when Cisco publishes a replacement. Creation is non-idempotent: ambiguous POST results are not retried and may already have created a resource. HTTP 2xx plus validated identity proves acceptance, not review/follow-up. Generic APIs are used because no feedback atomic exists.

properties.description: Validates schema enums, lengths, email formats, JSON arrays, cross-field rules, and optional sentinels before constructing feedback.FeedbackPost. Diagnostic outputs never echo the Comment, Email, or alternative email values. The requestBody query is transport-only and must not be copied into terminal outputs or logs.
properties.display_name: Validate feedback inputs and build request
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
validationStatus = 'helper-failure'
validationStatusCode = '500'
validationMessage = 'Feedback input validation did not complete.'
validationResultJson = json.dumps({'error': 'Feedback input validation helper failed'}, separators=(',', ':'))
requestBody = ''
EMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile("^[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*$")
try:
    feedbackType = sys.argv[10]
    comment = str(sys.argv[2])
    email = sys.argv[11]
    accountName = sys.argv[12]
    evaluation = sys.argv[13]
    if sys.argv[22]:
        raise ValueError(sys.argv[22])
    followUp = json.loads(sys.argv[21])
    alternativeText = sys.argv[14]
    satisfaction = int(sys.argv[15])
    if sys.argv[24]:
        raise ValueError(sys.argv[24])
    surveyCompleted = json.loads(sys.argv[23])
    errors = []
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[16]))
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[17]))
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[18]))
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[19]))
    errors.extend(json.loads(sys.argv[20]))
    if satisfaction < -1 or satisfaction > 10:
        errors.append('Product Satisfaction Scale must be -1 to omit it or an integer from 0 through 10.')
    if feedbackType != 'Survey' and surveyCompleted:
        errors.append('Survey Completed must remain false unless Feedback Type is Survey.')
    alternatives = []
    try:
        alternatives = json.loads(alternativeText or '[]')
        if not isinstance(alternatives, list):
            raise ValueError('not an array')
        if len(alternatives) > 5:
            errors.append('Alternative Follow-up Emails must contain at most five entries.')
        normalized = []
        for entry in alternatives:
            if not isinstance(entry, str) or not EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(entry.strip()):
                errors.append('Every Alternative Follow-up Emails entry must be a valid email address string.')
                continue
            normalized.append(entry.strip())
        alternatives = normalized
        if len(set((address.lower() for address in alternatives))) != len(alternatives):
            errors.append('Alternative Follow-up Emails must not contain duplicates.')
    except Exception:
        alternatives = []
        errors.append('Alternative Follow-up Emails must be a valid JSON string array.')
    if alternatives and (not followUp):
        errors.append('Follow Up must be true when Alternative Follow-up Emails are supplied.')
    if errors:
        validationStatus = 'invalid'
        validationStatusCode = '400'
        validationMessage = 'Feedback inputs are invalid. Review the named fields; submitted values are intentionally omitted from diagnostics.'
        validationResultJson = json.dumps({'error': 'Input validation failed', 'issueCount': len(errors), 'details': errors}, separators=(',', ':'))
    else:
        feedbackData = {'ClassId': 'feedback.FeedbackData', 'ObjectType': 'feedback.FeedbackData', 'Type': feedbackType, 'Comment': comment, 'Email': email, 'AccountName': accountName, 'FollowUp': followUp, 'SurveyCompleted': surveyCompleted}
        if feedbackType == 'Evaluation':
            feedbackData['Evaluation'] = evaluation
        if alternatives:
            feedbackData['AlternativeFollowUpEmails'] = alternatives
        if satisfaction >= 0:
            feedbackData['ProductSatisfactionScale'] = satisfaction
        payload = {'ClassId': 'feedback.FeedbackPost', 'ObjectType': 'feedback.FeedbackPost', 'FeedbackData': feedbackData}
        requestBody = json.dumps(payload, separators=(',', ':'))
        validationStatus = 'ready'
        validationStatusCode = '200'
        validationMessage = 'Feedback inputs are valid and the privacy-minimized request is ready.'
        validationResultJson = json.dumps({'validated': True, 'feedbackType': feedbackType, 'alternativeEmailCount': len(alternatives), 'satisfactionProvided': satisfaction >= 0}, separators=(',', ':'))
except Exception as exc:
    validationStatus = 'helper-failure'
    validationStatusCode = '500'
    validationMessage = 'Feedback input validation failed technically (' + type(exc).__name__ + '). Submitted values are intentionally omitted.'
    validationResultJson = json.dumps({'error': 'Feedback input validation helper failed', 'exceptionType': type(exc).__name__}, separators=(',', ':'))
    requestBody = ''

Submits a feedback.FeedbackPost using the selected Intersight endpoint and its default runtime user. A generic request is required because no purpose-built feedback atomic is present; replace it with a supported purpose-built atomic when available. This operation is intentionally non-idempotent: automatic retry after an ambiguous transport failure could create duplicate feedback.

Separates ambiguous transport failure from a confirmed non-2xx response. Because the POST is non-idempotent, transport failure warns that the submission may already exist and must not be retried automatically; a confirmed HTTP failure preserves the returned status code without echoing a potentially sensitive body.

properties.script:
import json
import sys

responseStatus = "helper-failure"
responseStatusCode = "500"
responseMessage = "Feedback response validation did not complete."
responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Feedback response validation helper failed"}, separators=(",", ":"))
try:
    body = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
    if not isinstance(body, dict):
        responseStatus = "invalid"
        responseStatusCode = "502"
        responseMessage = "Cisco Intersight returned a non-object feedback response; submitted values are intentionally omitted."
        responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Invalid feedback response shape"}, separators=(",", ":"))
    else:
        moid = body.get("Moid")
        objectType = body.get("ObjectType") or body.get("ClassId")
        if not isinstance(moid, str) or not moid.strip() or objectType != "feedback.FeedbackPost":
            responseStatus = "invalid"
            responseStatusCode = "502"
            responseMessage = "Cisco Intersight returned a feedback response without a valid Moid and feedback.FeedbackPost type."
            responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Feedback response identity validation failed"}, separators=(",", ":"))
        else:
            responseStatus = "ready"
            responseStatusCode = "201"
            responseMessage = "Cisco Intersight accepted the feedback submission."
            responseResultJson = json.dumps({"created":True,"Moid":moid.strip(),"ObjectType":"feedback.FeedbackPost"}, separators=(",", ":"))
except Exception as exc:
    responseStatus = "helper-failure"
    responseStatusCode = "500"
    responseMessage = "Feedback response validation failed technically (" + type(exc).__name__ + "); submitted values are intentionally omitted."
    responseResultJson = json.dumps({"error":"Feedback response validation helper failed","exceptionType":type(exc).__name__}, separators=(",", ":"))
